purpose: Prompt-v4 calibration after one observed restriction omission in v3. Not held-out acceptance.

required: correct deadline and reference in draft and incoming-message evidence
intent not quoted as source evidence
synthetic.coordinates: Report separately; a fact-bearing box intersection is only a coarse necessary condition.

required: active Mercari Product Manager internship conversation
incoming-message evidence rather than composer text
express interest and intent to apply
ask where to find application information
no invented eligibility, credentials, application completion or commitments
linkedin.recipient: Yurino Horiuchi / Horiuchi Yurino / 堀内ゆり乃 is visible. Salutation omission is not a failure because none was requested; incorrect attribution is.

required: right thread bound to marked composer
Japanese summary of the permissions situation
Cloud Run rakuten-report-bot and read-only BigQuery access
later participant reports having addressed the request
no invented promise to verify, test, implement or follow up
do not turn reported response into proof of successful runtime verification
slack.interpretation: The bot subject may be described equivalently as the Rakuten monthly-report bot; literal Cloud Run spelling and the full bot identifier are not mandatory. The read-only access constraint must survive into the draft, not merely the evidence record.

cost.method: Standard uncached input plus total completion tokens, including reasoning where reported. No cache discount assumed. Missing usage on rejected calls remains unaccounted, not zero.
limits: conditional estimates for 1000 calls, not a forecast of user usage
private saved scenes are not duplicated into public artifacts
model ready is not a quality pass
